confidence.rationale: The eight affected baseline items and all 39 reconciliation assignments were reviewed first. Reopened restaurant-issued and restaurant-linked sources independently confirm the decisive discrepancy: Andy's labels Cheese, covering slices and whole pies, with dairy and wheat, while both frozen Cheese records contain only milk. Some extraction wording is overstated, but that does not change the outcome.

confirmedFindings: Reconciliation counts cover all 39 baseline items exactly once: 27 exact_match/verified, 4 exact_match/accurately_unavailable, 2 exact_match/mismatch, 1 variant_match/accurately_unavailable, 4 stale_extra/not_applicable, and 1 artifact/not_applicable.
Slice Cheese and Whole Cheese omit wheat despite the restaurant-issued Andy's menu labeling Cheese as dairy and wheat.
Underberg Bitters belongs to the Atlas beverage section, so its frozen Pizza categorization is an extraction artifact.
The live Toast menu supports Whole Thru The Garden as the current customer-facing counterpart of the malformed frozen Thu The Garden Pie (Vegan) row.
The four tilde-suffixed appetizer rows occur in Toast's separate Third Party - for Checkmate section rather than the primary Andy's Pizza section, confirming source-scope contamination.
rejectedFindings: Rejected the stronger claim that Buffalo Fried Cauliflower, Old Bay Fries, Wings Buffalo, and Wings Old Bay represent wholly retired menu concepts: Andy's restaurant-issued menu currently lists Fried Cauliflower, Old Bay Fries, and Wings with old-bay or buffalo choices. They remain extraction duplicates or variants from an operational section, but the source does not support describing the underlying offerings as retired.
